measures.description: This cost metric is specific to AWS and corresponds to the lineItem/BlendedCost column of the CUR file. This metric “blends” the impact of reserved instances and savings plans.
measures.label: Cost (Total Blended)
measures.name: invoiced_cost

measures.description: For Consolidated Billing accounts, the effective rate for the line item calculated as an average of the cost of identical instances operating in that hour in the same Availability Zone.
measures.label: Rate (Blended)
measures.name: blended_rate

measures.description: The number of computing resources used in the units specified by each service. For example, your service may determine pricing by the amount of storage, number of requests, or hours of operation.
measures.label: Usage Hours
measures.name: usage_hours

measures.description: Describes the number of data requests from a database service.
measures.label: I/O Requests
measures.name: io_requests

measures.description: The number of computing resources used in the units specified by each service. For example, your service may determine pricing by the amount of storage, number of requests, or hours of operation.
measures.label: Requests
measures.name: requests

measures.description: References byte-hours, which corresponds to the number of bytes stored on an AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI storage service in a particular hourly period.
measures.label: GiB Months
measures.name: gb_months

measures.description: A gigabyte-hour refers to the number of gigabytes stored on a cloud platform in a particular hourly period.
measures.label: GiB Hours
measures.name: byte_hours

measures.description: The invoice date for any cost item as provided by the cloud vendor. This is reported in "Mon DD, YYYY" format. Cloud consumption during the month is usually given an invoice date of the first day of that month.
measures.label: Invoice Date
measures.name: invoice_date

measures.description: The calendar date - formatted "Mon DD, YYYY" (Aug 9, 2022).
measures.label: Date
measures.name: date

measures.description: The calendar year any cost item was occurred, formatted YYYY (for example, 2022).
measures.label: Year
measures.name: year

measures.description: The month any cost item was incurred, formatted "Mon". Examples "Jun", "Jul", "Aug". This is useful for looking at costs by month for any year (such as show costs that occurred in July of any year).
measures.label: Month (Category)
measures.name: month

measures.description: The numeric calendar day (for example, "Aug 9, 2022" => 9).
measures.label: Day
measures.name: day

measures.description: The day of week (for example, Monday).
measures.label: Day of Week
measures.name: day_of_week

measures.description: The cloud vendor associated with the cost item. Valid values are Amazon, Azure, GCP and OCI.
measures.label: Vendor
measures.name: vendor

measures.description: The official seller of services. Using this dimension allows you to separate marketplace charges from your other cloud costs.
measures.label: Seller
measures.name: seller

measures.description: The official product name as provided by the vendor (for example, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud, GCP Cloud Storage, Microsoft.Compute or OCI Compute).
measures.label: Product Name
measures.name: service_name

measures.description: The region in which a resource exists or a usage charge occurred, for example: us-east-1 for AWS, US East for Azure, us-east1 for GCP and us-ashburn-1 for OCI.
measures.label: Region
measures.name: region

measures.description: This field is specific to AWS, it corresponds to the letter for a specific zone in which an instance exists or a usage charge occured within an Availability Zone. This field is not used for Azure, GCP or OCI.
measures.label: Zone
measures.name: zone

measures.description: A combination of the region and zone in which a resource exists. For example, us-east-1a.
measures.label: Availability Zone
measures.name: region_zone

measures.description: Description of the type of usage for this line item. This description matches the description on the Bills page, including the average price of any usage that is based on a volume pricing tier.
measures.label: Item Description
measures.name: item_description

measures.description: The unique identifier related to the AWS management account, Azure EA/MCA agreement, GCP Billing Account or OCI Root Tenancy.
measures.label: Payer Account ID
measures.name: account_identifier

measures.description: The name related to the AWS management account, Azure EA/MCA agreement, GCP Billing Account or OCI Root Tenancy. Depending on your situation this value may fall back to the unique billing ID.
measures.label: Payer Account Name
measures.name: account_name

measures.description: The name given by the customer that's attached to each AWS Account, Azure Subscription, GCP Project or OCI Tenancy.
measures.label: Account Name
measures.name: vendor_account_name

measures.description: The unique identifier related to a AWS Account, Azure Subscription, GCP Project or OCI Tenancy.
measures.label: Account ID
measures.name: vendor_account_identifier

measures.description: Specifies operational details of the usage line item. The following example describes Amazon EC2 High-Memory Double ExtraLarge Instance box usage in the US West (Oregon) region. Example: USW1-BoxUsage:m2.2xlarge
measures.label: Usage Type
measures.name: usage_type

measures.description: The week any cost item was incurred, formatted "WW". Examples "01", "15", "52". This is useful for looking at costs by the week for any year (such as show costs that occurred in week 1 of any year).
measures.label: Week (Category)
measures.name: week

measures.description: The amount of data transferred in a particular time period.
measures.label: Data Transfer (GiB)
measures.name: bytes_transferred

measures.description: A new dimension created by Cloudability to break costs into Usage, One-Time Charges, Recurring Charges, Amortized Charges, Credits, Taxes, or Rounding.
measures.label: Transaction Type
measures.name: transaction_type

measures.description: The category of VM or Database an instance belongs to. Common categories include General Purpose, Compute Optimized and Memory Optimized.
measures.label: Instance Category
measures.name: instance_category

measures.description: This is the default cost metric throughout Cloudability. It is a “cash” metric and simply represents the invoiced amount associated with any cost item as reported by the cloud vendor.
measures.label: Cost (Total)
measures.name: unblended_cost

measures.description: The cost per hour for a line item. This is summarized across the hours of a day.
measures.label: Rate (Unblended)
measures.name: unblended_rate

measures.description: The amount of reserved computing hours used during the reporting period.
measures.label: Reserved Hours
measures.name: reserved_hours

measures.description: The amount of on demand computing hours used during the reporting period.
measures.label: On Demand Hours
measures.name: on_demand_hours

measures.description: The percentage of total hours used during the period where an RI was applied.
measures.label: Reserved Coverage Rate
measures.name: reserved_utilization_rate

measures.description: Generic usage quantity. Units will vary on dimensions and filters.
measures.label: Usage Quantity
measures.name: usage_quantity

measures.description: The family of VM or Database an instance belongs to. This will typically form the prefix to the full instance type definition.
measures.label: Instance Family
measures.name: instance_family

measures.description: The size of VM or Database. This is correlated to key resource attributes such as the number of CPUs and available memory.
measures.label: Instance Size
measures.name: instance_size

measures.description: The  full identifier of the type of VM or Database instance, capturing both the family and size. This value forms one complete component of the product SKU (used alongside location and OS).
measures.label: Instance Type
measures.name: instance_type

measures.description: Handy Cloudability-defined dimension for understanding the type of compute for some AWS services such as EC2 and RDS.
measures.label: Compute Usage Type
measures.name: compute_usage_type

measures.description: The resource is the base entity that users can work with in the cloud. Examples are Instance Ids, Lambda Functions, S3 storage buckets.
measures.label: Resource ID
measures.name: resource_identifier

measures.description: The count of ?unique? resource ids in the period specified.
measures.label: Resource Count
measures.name: resource_identifier_count

measures.description: The operation data represents the action that was taken on the asset.  This often relates to a CLI command.
measures.label: Operation
measures.name: operation

measures.description: The operating system for VMs as reported by the cloud vendors for billing purposes. Example values: Linux, Windows, Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
measures.label: Operating System
measures.name: operating_system

measures.description: The database or cache engine (for example, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL or Redis).
measures.label: Engine
measures.name: engine

measures.description: This is an “accrual” cost metric, representing the consumed cost during any period. This metric is handy for ensuring commitments are allocated to the time and place they are consumed.
measures.label: Cost (Amortized)
measures.name: total_amortized_cost

measures.description: The unique ID of the commitment (such as reserved instance and savings plan) tied to any cost item as provided by the cloud vendor.
measures.label: Reservation ID
measures.name: reservation_identifier

measures.description: A standardized dimension created by Cloudability to consolidate similar values of Usage Type into a single high-level family (e.g. Data Transfer, Storage, API Request). To see the original values, add the Usage Type dimension.
measures.label: Usage Family
measures.name: usage_family

measures.description: The payment mode for the cost items. Valid values are: On-Demand, Savings Plan, Reserved and Spot. This is a reporting dimension defined by Cloudability to support multi-cloud cost categorization.
measures.label: Lease Type
measures.name: lease_type

measures.description: A dimension defined by Cloudability that standardizes product naming conventions for AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI. To surface the original product names, use the Product Name dimension instead.
measures.label: Service Name
measures.name: enhanced_service_name

measures.description: The month and year of any cost item (formatted Month YYYY) useful for proper chronological sorting. Examples: July 2021, September 2022.
measures.label: Month (Year)
measures.name: year_month

measures.description: The week and year of any cost item (formatted YYYY-WW) useful for proper chronological sorting. Examples: 2021-06, 2022-52.
measures.label: Week (Year)
measures.name: year_week

measures.description: The amount by which the cost was adjusted.
measures.label: Cost Adjustment
measures.name: cost_adjusted

measures.description: Built from the cost (total) metric, this metric adjusts the figures to allow for any custom pricing rules. It only appears for Cloudability customers who have turned on the custom pricing module.
measures.label: Cost (Adjusted)
measures.name: adjusted_cost

measures.description: Description of the cost adjustment rule applied.
measures.label: Cost Adjustment Description
measures.name: cost_adjustment_description

measures.description: Built from the cost (amortized) metric, this metric adjusts the figures to allow for any custom pricing rules. It only appears for Cloudability customers who have turned on the custom pricing module.
measures.label: Cost (Adjusted Amortized)
measures.name: total_adjusted_amortized_cost

measures.description: This metric represents cost items as if they were charged at the public on-demand rate. This means the impact of any commitments, spot instance pricing, and custom pricing are removed.
measures.label: Cost (List)
measures.name: public_on_demand_cost

measures.description: AWS specific dimension identifying the tenancy of EC2 instances. Three valid values are shared, host and dedicated. "shared" is the default value.
measures.label: Tenancy
measures.name: tenancy

measures.description: The commitment offering tied to any cost item. Example values include “standard” and “convertible” reserved instances, “EC2InstanceSavingsPlans” and “ComputeSavingsPlans” for savings plans.
measures.label: Reservation Class
measures.name: offering_class

measures.description: The Kubernetes "Cluster Name" that the underlying cost items - such as VM, storage and network costs - belong to. The value matches the name setup by your admin when provisioning the cluster within Cloudability.
measures.label: Cluster Name
measures.name: container_cluster_name

measures.description: Kubernetes Namespace
measures.label: Namespace
measures.name: container_namespace

measures.description: The invoice ID that corresponds to any charged cost item, as provided by AWS. Data is not currently available for Azure, GCP and OCI.
measures.label: Invoice ID
measures.name: invoice_id

measures.description: Lowest level of the ATUM Service taxonomy (e.g. Threat & Vulnerability Management).
measures.label: ATUM Service Name
measures.name: atum_service_name

measures.description: Highest level of the ATUM Service taxonomy (e.g., workplace, business, platform, infrastructure).
measures.label: ATUM Service Type
measures.name: atum_service_type

measures.description: Middle level of the ATUM Service taxonomy (e.g., client computing, communication & collaboration).
measures.label: ATUM Service Category
measures.name: atum_service_category

measures.description: This dimension displays the ancestry information of a given GCP project (for example billing account/folder[1..n]).  This information is gathered from "project.ancestry" column from GCP billing data.
measures.label: GCP Ancestry Numbers
measures.name: ancestry_numbers

measures.description: 3 letter ISO currency code.
measures.label: Currency Code
measures.name: currency_code

measures.description: This is calculated by dividing the sum of the used resources for the container by the total used resources of all containers running on the same hardware, and then multiplying it by the cost of the hardware
measures.label: Fairshare Cost (Adjusted)
measures.name: adjusted_fairshare_cost

measures.description: The utilized cost refers to the cost incurred by the resources utilized by a workload for a given time range (can be further broken down or grouped by cluster, namespace, labels)
measures.label: Utilized Cost (Adjusted)
measures.name: adjusted_utilized_cost

measures.description: The idle cost refers to the cost incurred by resources that are not used by any workload for a given time range
measures.label: Idle Cost (Adjusted)
measures.name: adjusted_idle_cost

measures.description: This is calculated by dividing the sum of the used resources for the container by the total used resources of all containers running on the same hardware, and then multiplying it by the cost of the hardware
measures.label: Fairshare Cost (Adjusted Amortized)
measures.name: adjusted_amortized_fairshare_cost

measures.description: The utilized cost refers to the cost incurred by the resources utilized by a workload for a given time range (can be further broken down or grouped by cluster, namespace, labels)
measures.label: Utilized Cost (Adjusted Amortized)
measures.name: adjusted_amortized_utilized_cost

measures.description: The idle cost refers to the cost incurred by resources that are not used by any workload for a given time range
measures.label: Idle Cost (Adjusted Amortized)
measures.name: adjusted_amortized_idle_cost

measures.description: This field is specific to Azure and OCI. It corresponds to the identifier used to get specific meter pricing.
measures.label: Part Number
measures.name: part_number

measures.description: The name or description of the product or service that was ordered or consumed (Azure specific).
measures.label: Azure Reservation Order Name
measures.name: azure_reservation_order_name

measures.description: The name of the purchased reservation instance (Azure specific).
measures.label: Reservation Name
measures.name: reservation_name

measures.description: Normalized CPU hours are calculated by multiplying the CPU hours used by the number of vCPUs used.
measures.label: vCPU Hours
measures.name: vcpu_hours

measures.description: Estimated Carbon emissions by a resource in metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent - MTCO2e
measures.label: Estimated Carbon Emissions (MTCO2e)
measures.name: carbon_emissions

measures.description: Power consumed by a resource in Kilo Watt Hours - kWh
measures.label: Power Consumed (kWh)
measures.name: kwh_consumption

measures.description: Resources are named entities, and the resource_name is its identifier. Each resource has its own unique resource name. This value is from the CSP billing files.
measures.label: Resource Name
measures.name: resource_name

measures.description: High-level IT service category
measures.label: ATUM Tower
measures.name: atum_tower

measures.description: Subcategory within the ATUM Tower
measures.label: ATUM Sub-Tower
measures.name: atum_subtower
